name: 13-cross-viridian-forest
objective: Cross Viridian Forest from the south entrance to the north exit. It is a maze of trees with three bug catchers in it whose battles cannot be run from - pathing the forest with their sight cones blocked gives no route at all - and tall grass throwing wild encounters the whole way.
evidence: map=0x2F — wCurMap $D35E. VIRIDIAN_FOREST_NORTH_GATE is const index 47. The forest's three bug catchers each have a flag (EVENT_BEAT_VIRIDIAN_FOREST_TRAINER_0..2, wEventFlags $D7F3 bits 2,3,4), but none of them is crossing it: the route past them is avoidable and beating them is not the milestone.
